title: Memorial Meeting For The Anniversary Of The Execution Of 72 Victims Of The Kwangtung Uprising

page_data.en:
Misc. File No. 65/35
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTRY
West Hongke Station
Date March 29, 1935.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Memorial Meeting for the anniversary of the Execution
of 72 Victims of the Kwangtung Uprising.

Made by D.S.I. Shields. Forwarded by John Swaton.

Sir,
Between 9.30 a.m. and 10 a.m. 29-3-35 in the Chamber of
Commerce, about 300 people held a memorial meeting for the
anniversary of the execution of 72 victims of the Kwangtung
Uprising.
Mr. Woo Kai See, leader of local Kuomintang, acted as
chairman of the meeting.
No untoward incident.

J.J. Shields
D.S.I.

B.D.O. "C" Division.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

File
9/5

（左侧手写批注：no such meeting took place in the Chamber of Commerce on March 29 #G）

杂项档案号 65/35
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S. B. 登记处
西虹口巡捕房
日期：1935年3月29日。

报告

事由（全称）：纪念广东起义72烈士就义周年大会。

呈报人：副督察长希尔德斯（Shields）。转呈人：约翰·斯瓦顿（John Swaton）。

敬启者，
1935年3月29日上午9时30分至10时之间，在总商会内，约300人举行集会，纪念广东起义72名遇难者就义周年。
当地国民党领导人吴开先（Woo Kai See，音译）担任会议主席。
未发生任何意外事件。

J.J. 希尔德斯（Shields）
副督察长

“C”区助理总监。

特务科主管警官。

归档
9/5

（左侧手写批注：3月29日总商会并未举行此类会议 #G）

Movement of Notables
To Nanking
Departed at 11 p.m. March 29:-
Chu Pei Teh, Chief of Staff of the Military
Affairs Committee.
Chu Ming Nyi, member of the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang.

From Nanking
Arrived at 7.15 a.m. March 30:-
Yu Yu Jen, President of the Control Yuan.
Heu Yao Tsu, Chinese Minister to Turkey.
Yang Teh Chao, member of the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang.

Anniversary of the Execution of 72 Victims of the
Kwangtung Uprising (1911)
In observance of the Anniversary of the Execution
of 72 Victims of the Kwangtung Uprising (1911), meetings
of the usual Kuomintang order were held at the following
places on the morning of March 29:-

| Venue | Sponsored by | Attendance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| People's Educational Institute, Wen Miao Park, Wen Miao Road, Nantao. | The local Kuomintang Headquarters. | 130 persons, mostly Kuomintang members. |
| 14 Tai Zuen Li, Chao Ka Road, West Gate. | The Chinese Seamen's Special Kuomintang. | 60 seamen. |
| Huang Hwa Kiang Middle School, Sung's Garden, Ts Yuen Road, Chapei. | Huang Hwa Kiang Middle School. | 320 persons, teachers and students of the school. |
| 215 Police Station Road, Pootung. | 8th District (Pootung) Kuomintang. | 40 persons, Kuomintang members in Pootung. |

纪念广东起义（1911年）72烈士就义周年
为纪念广东起义（1911年）72名遇难者就义周年，3月29日上午在下列地点举行了常规的国民党秩序集会：

| 地点 | 主办方面 | 出席人数 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 南市文庙路文庙公园民众教育馆。 | 当地国民党党部。 | 130人，多为国民党党员。 |
| 西门曹家路太尊里14号。 | 中国海员特别国民党党部。 | 60名海员。 |
| 闸北慈源路宋园黄华江中学。 | 黄华江中学。 | 320人，该校师生。 |
| 浦东警站路215号。 | 第八区（浦东）国民党党部。 | 40人，浦东国民党党员。 |

page_data.en:
March 30, 1935

Political (2)

Apart from the above, local Chinese Government
organs, leading industrial concerns and educational
institutions observed the occasion as a holiday and
the Chinese national flag was flown at half mast.
page_data.zh:
1935年3月30日

政治类 (2)

除上述活动外，当地中国政府机关、主要工商企业及教育机构均将此日作为假日纪念，并降半旗致哀。
